title: Illustration and copy / campaign sequence

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Give abstract benefits a visible metaphor so people can connect a claim with an understandable object.
strategic_value: Textured planes, locks, flowers and jars can make Wise’s service language concrete while sharing a recognizable material treatment.
demonstration: The film pairs short headlines with animated three-dimensional objects, including a paper plane, flower, lock, flag, calendar, globe, palm and jars.
practical_value: Compare which metaphor best supports a particular benefit without relying on the headline alone.

content_islands.name: Message pairs
content_islands.spec: Give each object a short related headline on a flat color ground.

content_islands.name: Object behavior
content_islands.spec: Animate the textured forms while retaining generous separation from the words.

reference_purposes.Expression: The film pairs short headlines with animated three-dimensional objects, including a paper plane, flower, lock, flag, calendar, globe, palm and jars.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates short benefit messages paired with specific illustrated metaphors.
